title: Full Dispatch Day
description: Run a whole dispatch shift end to end on the board: three shipments assigned cleanly to three different vehicles and drivers, then a scheduling mistake that double-books one driver, and confirm the board surfaces the problem the instant it happens.
successCondition: A test drags three distinct shipments from Unassigned onto three different vehicle columns, each with a different driver and non-overlapping time slot, and confirms no conflict banner appears and all three rows are clean in the Schedule table. It then creates a fourth assignment for the same driver as one of the first three with an overlapping time window, and confirms: the conflict banner appears with role="alert" naming the affected driver, and both the new and the original conflicting row in the Schedule table now show the highlighted/conflict styling — while the two untouched assignments remain unhighlighted.
hints: Reuse the same driver deliberately for the fourth assignment and choose a start time that overlaps one of the first three's 2-hour window — the conflict check only looks at time-range overlap on a shared driver or vehicle.
Check the banner's exact driver reference (email) matches the one you double-booked, not a generic "a conflict exists" message.
